title: Tilt: 184 Pinball and Pachinko Sound Effects
shortText: 184 pinball and pachinko sounds: flippers, bumpers, rolling loops and peg ladders.
html:
Tilt is 184 pinball and pachinko sound effects for Unity, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker and any game engine: one wooden table and one pachinko machine.

Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. A free demo of 20 sounds is on this page.

@@IMG:shot_0_a_ball_in_play.gif@@

What is inside

184 sounds · 24 seamless loops · 14 ladders · WAV + OGG · 20 sound free demo

  • Flippers (16 files): left and right, firing, held on the coil and dropping, plus the bat meeting the ball at four strengths.
  • Bumpers and targets (34): pop bumpers in three voices, slingshots, a drop target bank and its reset, rollovers, posts, and a spinner hit five ways.
  • Ball handling (28): the plunger, four launch strengths, a saucer, a ball lock, multiball, two balls clacking, the drain.
  • The ball rolling (15): wood, plastic ramp and steel wire, each at three speeds as seamless loops, with the joins between them.
  • Machine state (29): tilt, knocker, coin in, score chimes, score reels, bonus count, game start and game over.
  • Peg boards (42): peg hits in glass, brass and stone, each a 10 step ladder that climbs with the shot, plus the bucket and board clear.
  • The pachinko machine (20): nail hits, falling balls, the launcher, tulips, the big gate and the payout.

@@IMG:shot_1_the_table.png@@

Each part sits where it stands on a table. Every waveform is a shipped file.

@@IMG:shot_4_ladders.png@@

Wire the rung to a number your game already has: the hit count, the ball speed, the pull.

Works with

Unity, Unreal, Godot 4, GameMaker, RPG Maker MV and MZ, and HTML5: use the WAV or OGG files directly. Loop points are written into the loop files. Import notes are in the readme.

Try it free

The demo on this page holds a whole ball from the plunger to the drain, every state of the left flipper, a drop target bank, three steps of a peg ladder and two pachinko sounds.

Licence and how it was made

Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. Do not resell the sounds as a pack. Every sound is synthesised in code, with no generative audio model, samples or recordings. The code and the cover art were made with AI tools. Nothing here is a tune or a voice.

Versions

v1.0.0: first release, 184 sounds.
